label: PF Backlog 705
title: Memory Governance & Lifecycle: explicit supersession tracking, temporal expiration, validity windows, and audit logging
body:
## Problem / why
Old decisions and stale rules linger indefinitely in memory, conflicting with newer architecture and misleading agents.

## Goal & value
Implement full lifecycle governance for memory records with explicit supersession, temporal expiration, and complete mutation audit trails.

## Reference Documents
- `docs/Product_Forge_Agent_Memory_Architecture_Integration.md#section-11`
- `docs/Product_Forge_Agent_Memory_Architecture_Integration.md#section-12`

## In scope
- Supersession mechanism (superseded_by pointer, status=superseded).
- Temporal validity engine filtering out expired records (valid_until < now).
- Cryptographic provenance linking each memory to commit SHA, run ID, or operator decision.
- Append-only audit log of memory creation, updates, and supersession.

## Out of scope
- Hard-deleting historical memories without audit preservation.

## Definition of Done
- Lifecycle tests prove superseded records are never injected as active authority.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.
